title: Unify AI Sentiment + Market Intel, fix passcode lock/unlock gating, and replace Voting page with coming-soon

requirements.text: Combine AI Sentiment and Market Intelligence into a single unified page/route so users access both from one place (no separate AI Sentiment page experience). Update navigation accordingly so there is only one entry point for the combined section.

quotes: Combine AI sentiment and market Intel in only one

acceptanceCriteria: There is one primary route/page for the combined experience (Market Intel + AI Sentiment).
Bottom navigation no longer presents AI Sentiment as a separate destination from Market Intel (either removed or redirected to the unified page).
No blank/placeholder AI sentiment page is reachable (current AISentimentPage is not exposed as an empty page).

requirements.text: Fix Market Intel unlock/lock behavior using passcode "B2420075112009P" so that (a) AI Sentiment content remains accessible without unlocking, and (b) trading signals and any market-intelligence computation/results remain inaccessible until unlocked; re-locking must reliably remove access and prevent signals from displaying again until re-unlocked.

quotes: fix code unlock and lock B2420075112009P and make sure that signal providing required unlock while the content of AI sentiment must remain open

acceptanceCriteria: When the user is locked (no Market Intel access), the unified page still renders AI Sentiment content normally.
When locked, Market Intel signal UI is not shown and signal data is not fetched/computed (no standard or binary signal queries execute while locked).
Entering passcode "B2420075112009P" unlocks Market Intel and enables selecting assets/timeframes and viewing signals.
Locking (with passcode) reliably revokes access, clears any previously displayed signal results, and returns the Market Intel area to the locked state without requiring a refresh.
After locking, attempting to refresh or change assets/timeframes does not show any signals unless unlocked again.

requirements.text: Improve and standardize the visual theme across all site sections/pages so the Interlink-ID-inspired styling is applied consistently (typography, spacing, contrast, card styles, backgrounds) and any sections still using mismatched/older styles are updated to match the rest of the site.

quotes: fix every other sections theme fix them more better

acceptanceCriteria: All major pages reachable from BottomNav use consistent theme primitives (background treatment, card styling, headings/body typography, and readable contrast in light/dark).
No page has noticeably broken readability (e.g., low-contrast text on similar background) compared to the unified theme.
Spacing and component styling feel consistent across pages (cards, buttons, section headers).

requirements.text: Update the Community Voting page to remove all existing voting/proposals UI and replace it with a single bold placeholder message: "Voting session will coming soon".

quotes: in vote section remove every content in it and write bold that voting session will coming soon

acceptanceCriteria: The /community-voting page displays only the bold text "Voting session will coming soon" and no other voting content, metrics, proposals, or buttons.
User-facing text matches exactly: "Voting session will coming soon".

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn components are read-only and must be composed, not modified).

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, and frontend/src/components/ui/*.
nonGoals: Do not add third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Do not add real-time sockets/chat or push notifications.
Do not introduce external databases or non-Motoko backend services.
Do not change the passcode value (must remain exactly "B2420075112009P").
